card.band: 20h. The surface is large: axis scale and ticks, label layout, legend and series. A frontier agent matches simple line and bar charts but not pie label layout or legend wrapping. A weaker model only gets structure.
card.cheat: The model cannot recall exact SVG output. The Node oracle and the generated corpus are kept out of the image.
card.grading: Differential. SVG outputs from a sealed Node ECharts run over a few thousand generated options are compared structurally, with element attributes at 0.01 tolerance and exact text. Score is the fraction of options matching, with per-chart-type buckets.
card.reference: Our reference is a Python port of the layout and zrender SVG path, estimated at 5-8k lines. It is validated against the upstream output.
card.task: /app ships the ECharts TypeScript source as specification, with no Node SSR binary. The agent writes a Python library that turns an option JSON for line, bar, scatter and pie charts with axes, legend, title and grid into the SVG string that ECharts' SSR renderer produces.

source_notes: SWE-smith profile (javascript): its suite runs in a container; test command: npm run test -- --verbose. The repo is used by a SWE-bench-family dataset.

facts.claim: apache/echarts has a 6.1.0 release (tag 6.1.0, marked Latest)
The 6.1.0 tag points to commit c5a48f5f97d23e5379720870b8444cd05b50ffb4, not 34f4d927
Seed pins 34f4d927 as 6.1.0; that commit is a Dependabot merge (PR #21777, bump brace-expansion) on the development branch, not the release
Repository licence is Apache License 2.0 (bundled d3.js under BSD-3-Clause)
ECharts has a zero-dependency, string-based server-side SVG renderer (renderer: 'svg', ssr: true, renderToSVGString()), introduced in 5.3.0, needing no DOM container
Full SSR renderer does not support legend click toggling or hover tooltips; pie is specially optimised for SSR; pie label layout is not specifically documented
A Python library ports ECharts SVG SSR output without JavaScript (lookup for a complete Python implementation)
Seed band claim that a frontier agent matches simple line and bar charts but not pie label layout or legend wrapping, with dated public evidence

full_card.band: 20h tier. Frontier likely covers line and bar with axes and title; pie label placement and legend wrapping likely fail. No dated public evidence, so Band capped at 3.
full_card.build_cost: Reference 5-8k lines plus Node oracle harness and validation across chart types: estimated more than 5 days for us. Smoke build: npm build 332 s, suite amber (25 stable failures, 0 pass) so upstream jest is not a usable local check.
full_card.deliverable: Python library: option JSON (line, bar, scatter, pie; axes, legend, title, grid) to SVG string matching ECharts 6.1.0 SSR output.
full_card.gates_anticheat: Remove node and npm caches from image; no network at run time; oracle and corpus sealed; agent cannot call upstream renderer. Hidden corpus must be generated from a seed not in the image. Check for prebuilt dist or node_modules leaking the renderer.
full_card.grading_surface: Few thousand generated options run through sealed Node ECharts SSR; structural SVG compare, attributes at 0.01 tolerance, exact text; per-chart-type buckets.
full_card.local_fit: Pure Python at run time; Node only in sealed oracle; CPU-only; fits 8 cores / 16 GB.
full_card.lookup: partial: upstream TS SSR code is public and shipped as spec, which is the task's own guide; no Python port found; no complete Python implementation found.
full_card.provenance: apache/echarts, Apache-2.0, 67.5k stars; SSR SVG renderer public since 5.3.0. Seed pin 34f4d927 is a development merge; the 6.1.0 tag is c5a48f5. Re-pin to c5a48f5 before use.
full_card.reference: Python port of the layout and zrender SVG path, est. 5-8k lines, not yet written; validated against upstream output.
full_card.ships: ECharts TypeScript source as specification (history-less snapshot at the pinned tag). No Node binary, no node_modules, no built dist, no npm cache. Python-only toolchain for the agent.
full_card.similarity: Nearest l0 neighbours are internal seeds S-im-015 (0.206), S-im-021 (0.205), S-im-020 (0.192); none is a public task; not on CROWDED list; differs in subject (SVG chart rendering).

v1.kill_reason: As written (line, bar, scatter, pie with axes, legend, title and grid; 5-8k-line reference), no frontier trial is likely to reach 0.9 of the reference in 20h: the seed itself says pie label layout and legend wrapping fail. Revival: cut scope to line and bar with axes, title and grid, dropping pie and legend wrapping, then re-validate. Also flagged: the seed pin 34f4d927 is contradicted and must become c5a48f5; Build 2 risks K12 for full scope.

Band.why: No dated public evidence; seed's own claim implies frontier partial on pie and legend; capped at 3.

Build.why: Full 5-8k-line port plus oracle validation is likely over 5 days for us.

Fit.why: Pure Python at run time, CPU only; Node only in sealed oracle.

Hor.why: Large surface across four chart types, axes, legend, title, grid; 20h tier fits.

Lic.why: Apache-2.0 confirmed; bundled d3 BSD-3 is also permissive.

Multi.why: Per-chart-type buckets plus axis, legend, title and grid sub-buckets give steady partial credit.

Nov.why: Nearest neighbours are internal seeds at 0.19-0.21; no public SVG-SSR task or CROWDED match.

Real.why: Real Apache-2.0 repo with public SSR feature; seed pin contradicted (34f4d927 is a dev merge, tag is c5a48f5).

Ref.why: Reference is an unwritten Python port; upstream is strong ground truth but no complete permissive Python implementation exists yet.

Seal.why: Oracle and corpus sealable, but the TS source is shipped and upstream is public; node must be stripped to prevent direct execution.

Surf.why: Thousands of generated options with an executable Node oracle and unlimited generator.

spike_plan.kill_if: Output is non-deterministic across runs, SSR cannot run offline, or pie and legend SVG cannot be reproduced without the DOM.
spike_plan.pass_if: Deterministic byte-identical SVG across two runs for all four chart types; SSR renders offline after npm ci; at least one pie and one legend case render without error.
steps: Re-pin: clone apache/echarts, checkout tag 6.1.0 (c5a48f5), confirm HEAD matches and record the commit used.
npm ci at the tag; run the SSR build; confirm renderToSVGString works offline after install with renderer svg and ssr true.
Generate 10 options each for line, bar, scatter, pie with axes, legend, title and grid; render with Node; save SVG.
Run each option twice and diff bytes to confirm determinism.
Inspect the SSR source to see whether the zero-dependency string renderer is pure string output with no DOM dependency.
Check the jest SSR tests individually (the probe showed 25 stable failures); note which pass so the agent has a local check.
Measure the time to render 1000 options to size the oracle run.
Check that a Python-only image can run the spec without node; confirm the grader can run without the upstream toolchain.

v1.summary: The idea is real and licence-clean, but the seed pins a development commit (34f4d927) instead of the 6.1.0 tag (c5a48f5), and the full four-chart-type scope with 5-8k-line reference is likely unreachable for frontier agents in 20h (K9). A narrowed line-and-bar scope with axes, title and grid, re-pinned to c5a48f5, is the version to spike.
